new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Definition — minus-over-minus

new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the count 4+2=6; the recount `4+2 → (3+1)+2`; the three harmonics (Being, Becoming, Knowing/unKnowing); the compact `( = /) : (=/≠ ()) : (≠ =)`.

new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: derived line-by-line through the poem: Ground `0/1`, Definition `?/!`, Dynamis `−/+`, Pattern `X/x`, Context `AM/IS`, Real-isation `∞/dx`, bracketed by the parent `−/−` and the return `1/0` — the eight.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Definition — catuskoti-crossing
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: IS / IS-NOT / BOTH / NEITHER / **SILENCE**; "0 IS AND/OR IS-NOT EQUAL TO 1"; the fraction-reading of the vinculum.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Definition — immutable-subject
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the witness-argument; 0, Ø, X, Ø/X, (0/Ø)/(1/X); the charitable cogito (line 47; indexed CT-16); *isoid*, the flagged coinage.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Process — t1-geometry
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: "AND + OR — The Geometry of Space-Time": the six positions from binary strings; the E→W diametric leap; interval-gluing (0/1 as the generative operation of closed form); the 75% gap; the squared circle `⃞ + 𐀏`.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Process — phase-flip
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: `§1/0 — 0/1 = / ≠ 1/0`: the hinge of the file; Spencer-Brown re-entry → oscillation, memory, time; T1→T0 as third-person→first-person, IS→AM.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Process — t0-onto-logic
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: "AND/OR — The Onto-Logic": the slash-form table (`0/0 = %`, `0/1 → 0%`, `1/0 = ?/!`, `1/1 = 100%`); `?/!` at #3; chirality; the primed positions `#0′–#5′`.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Process — spanda

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Process — harmonics-symmetries
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: Mono-Poly = Becoming, Self-Identity = Being, Number-Word = Knowing/unKnowing; the three symmetries; the two axes crossing at #4; perspectival counting.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Quilt — psychology
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: `X = x`, `X = (x)`, `(X = x) = X/x`; the Axiom of Maria with the sesquitertian 4:3 as the recognition-fourth.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Quilt — number
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the perfect number; the additive-multiplicative hinge; zero bifurcation; six as *teleios* (6 ≡ 0 mod 6); seven convergences on the 4+2.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Quilt — topology
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: `ℝ²/ℤ² = T²`, `4g+2g = 6`, `π₁(T²) = ℤ×ℤ`; Lacan's torus from the couch; the pitch-space topology `ℝ/ℤ ≅ S¹` with the two whole-tone helices as bimba/pratibimba.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Quilt — recognition

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Music — foundational-ratios
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the canonical set `{1/1, 4/3, 3/4, 3/2, 2/3, 16/9, 9/8, 2/1}`; the load-bearing relation **16/9 × 9/8 = 2/1**; three convergent 9/8 derivations; the standing identity `0/1 + 1/0 = 1/1 ≡ 100%`.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Music — chromatic-substrates
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the chromatic basis (generator 9/8) and the fifths basis (generator 3/2); WT₀/WT₁; "the slash-flip is one operation whose interval-character is contextual."

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Music — pairing-grammar

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Music — lens-anchors
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: L0–L5 and L0′–L5′ with tradition anchors; "Lens-modulation is epistemic-mode-modulation"; the 8+4 partition; torus/Klein dual reading.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Music — diatonic-cf-grammar
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the seven CFs; the CF-cut producing the major scale; the tetrachord equation `4/3 × 9/8 × 4/3 = 2/1`; the diatonic as Klein double cover; major/minor as conjugate-form selection; the seven modes.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Music — field
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the 84-fold mode-tonic field; the 144-fold voicing landscape; the Pythagorean comma as aletheic remainder.

new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the cut: contrast, discrimination, selection; productive and counterfeit forms ([[../quilt/README|quilt]]-register severance; C23).

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Dia-Syn — chronic
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: synchronic (landscape: the configuration held together) and diachronic (trajectory: change, bifurcation, return); the two readings of one traversal — Symbolon Dynamics' operative pair.

new_locked_matheme_targets.title: Mono-Poly — poly
new_locked_matheme_targets.distinct_operation: the many notations: the inventory as plurality — each sign's office, each formalism's contact point, each register's dialect, held without collapse into one preferred encoding.
